decisive_items: Papillary fronds with slender fibrovascular cores that are lined by nonkeratinizing squamous epithelium
Shows mucin-containing goblet cells. Neither cytologic atypia nor atypical mitotic figures are present
exophytic, verrucous, skin-colored plaque on the right nasal vestibule
response.rationale: Exophytic papillary fronds with fibrovascular cores, nonkeratinizing squamous epithelium, and goblet cells without atypia fit squamous cell papilloma (fungiform type). R1 is a less specific synonym; R2 implies inverted growth not described; R4 contradicted by absent atypia.

rejected.why: Same entity but less specific label; R3 is the precise diagnosis.
Inverted papilloma typically shows endophytic growth, not exophytic fronds; description lacks inversion.
Verrucous carcinoma requires cytologic atypia/invasion, explicitly absent.
